comment: What goes into the VOQR package, one package per platform. pack.py builds it; verify-vsix.py proves where every byte came from.
modulesNote: Runtime modules that cannot be bundled: each loads native code, data files or its own code files relative to its own folder (node-record-lpcm16 loads its recorder that way; debug and ms are what it requires). Patterns are matched against the path inside the module; * also crosses folders. Native files are taken for the --target platform only. A module with "targets" ships only in those packages: node-record-lpcm16 opens the microphone on Linux only, micstream on Windows and macOS only.
bundleLookupsNote: verify-vsix.py refuses each line of dist/*.js that finds a file at run time relative to where its code sits (code bundled there finds nothing where its source was), except a line that holds one of these strings. log.ts writes its debug log in the extension's own folder: dist/.. in the bundle, as src/.. in the source.
voiceInputNote: A target named in withoutVoiceInput gets a package without the voice modules (no module above names it), and pack.py writes its reason into the package as voice-input.json; VOQR reads that file, starts no speech server and shows the reason when the mic button is pressed. A package without the file has voice input, and a voice module that fails to load there is reported as the error it is.

withoutVoiceInput.darwin-x64: Voice input is not available on Intel Macs in this version of VOQR: ONNX Runtime 1.24.3, which runs its voice-activity model, has no build for Intel Macs, and micstream 0.4.0, which opens the microphone on macOS, has none either.
withoutVoiceInput.win32-arm64: Voice input is not available on Windows on Arm in this version of VOQR: micstream 0.4.0, which opens the microphone on Windows, has no build for Windows on Arm.
withoutVoiceInput.linux-armhf: Voice input is not available on 32-bit Arm Linux in this version of VOQR: ONNX Runtime 1.24.3, which runs its voice-activity model, has no build for 32-bit Arm.
withoutVoiceInput.alpine-x64: Voice input is not available on Alpine Linux in this version of VOQR: ONNX Runtime 1.24.3, which runs its voice-activity model, has Linux builds only for glibc, which Alpine Linux does not use.
withoutVoiceInput.alpine-arm64: Voice input is not available on Alpine Linux in this version of VOQR: ONNX Runtime 1.24.3, which runs its voice-activity model, has Linux builds only for glibc, which Alpine Linux does not use.

denyExemptNote: The deny scan's exemptions (a pattern's key and the file names it is allowed in) are kept beside the pattern list, in a folder publish.sh never copies to the public repository, because a key of a short pattern can be recovered by guessing. pack.py and verify-vsix.py each refuse a config that carries exemptions itself, and each prints every exemption it applies.
